title.narrative: Project for the Revitalization of Infrastructure Supporting the Economy (PRISE)

description.narrative:
39. The goal is to contribute to the improvement of the road network to enhance mobility for goods and people to production areas, while reducing the social, economic, and financial costs of transportation.
Specific Objectives of the Project:
40. The project aims to:
o Improve road infrastructure through the construction, asphalting, and rehabilitation of approximately 301.8 km of road sections spanning five regions of the country.
o Revitalize trade by rehabilitating the railway linking Côte d'Ivoire to Burkina Faso.
o Conduct studies for the construction of a railway network linking Mali, Niger, and Burkina Faso.
o Strengthen the capacity of transport services.
41. Additionally, the project will focus on:
o Enhancing Regional Connectivity: Improve links between Benin, Togo, and Ghana by rehabilitating a crucial community road that supports both international transit and intra-regional traffic. This will facilitate smoother economic exchanges and integration within the region.
o Increasing Economic Efficiency: Boost the competitiveness and efficiency of the regional economy by promoting increased cross-border trade and reducing logistical bottlenecks. This includes optimizing the transport network to improve the flow of goods and services.
o Supporting Regional Development: Facilitate the growth and resilience
